about.text: The regional pecorino of the Marche, a cheese of raw sheep’s milk made across the region and most widely inland. The aged version is harder, with an oil-rubbed reddish rind.

links.name: Regione Marche technical sheet on pecorino

sources.text: The making, the ripening and the rind from the Marche technical sheet; its place in the regional list of traditional products.
